title: Ringo
notes:
First Canadian pressing with the correct title for track A2 "Have You Seen My Baby" on the label.

This still contains two misprints that are shared with the [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/3337601]other Canadian misprint release[/url]:
- Track A2 "Have You Seen My Baby" incorrectly listed as "Hold On" on the back cover.
- Track B3 "Six O'Clock" has an incorrect duration of 5:26 on the label.

Issued with a 24-page lithograph and lyric booklet.

Pressed by is uncredited and is identified by Customatrix plating info in combination with a 2.70" pressing ring on the labels.

Runouts are etched apart from [l186075]'s "TML" and [l586613]'s symbol "o", which are stamped.

On the back cover:
℗ 1973 The Gramophone Company, Limited
Manufactured by Apple Records, Inc.
Distributed in Canada by Capitol Records (Canada) Ltd.

On the labels:
Mfd. by Apple Records, Inc.
℗ 1973 EMI Records, Limited

In the booklet:
℗ 1973 EMI Records Limited
Recorded at Sunset Sound, Los Angeles and Apple Studios, London.
Additional recording at The Burbank Studios, Sound Labs, and Producer's Workshop, Los Angeles and E.M.I. Studios, London.
Remixed at Sound Labs, Los Angeles, and at NovA Sound, London
Mastering: The Mastering Lab, Los Angeles.
Photography and Art Direction for Camouflage Productions.

On the spine:
[Modern Graphics logo] Litho in Canada

Publishers:
[A1] Copyright © 1973 John Lennon
[A2] Copyright © 1970 January Music Corporation, a division of A. Schroeder International Ltd.
[A3, B2, B4] Copyright © 1973 Richoroony Ltd.
[A4] Copyright © 1973 The "Material" World Charitable Foundation
[A5] Copyright © 1960 Viva Music Inc.
[B1] Copyright © 1973 Braintree Music
[B3] Copyright © 1973 Paul And Linda McCartney, administered by McCartney Music, Inc. Co-published with ATV Music, Corp.
[B5] Copyright © 1973 Harrisongs Limited
